profile.headline: Software Engineer at Nava
profile.summary:
I’m a software engineer who enjoys turning confusing technical problems into clear, tested, maintainable solutions.
My recent work has centered on Java, Spring Boot, PostgreSQL, Jenkins, CI/CD, automated testing, OWASP security scanning, and healthcare pricing systems. I’ve worked on everything from SQL root-cause analysis and database migrations to JMeter load testing, Jenkins pipeline updates, dependency remediation, and production-metrics-based architecture decisions.
I like understanding why something broke, not only how to fix it. That curiosity shows up in how I debug, test, document, and collaborate with teammates. I’m drawn to work that asks me to learn the system, ask better questions, and leave behind evidence that the fix works.
Right now, I’m growing toward broader technical ownership: leading more design conversations, documenting architecture decisions, and helping coordinate work across services and teams.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New Castle, Delaware, United States · Remote
positions.description:
Backend-focused software engineer building and maintaining Java/Spring Boot systems for public-sector healthcare programs.
My work has included debugging production-impacting data workflows, improving CI/CD and security scanning, writing database migrations, validating changes across shared environments, and strengthening automated test coverage.
Highlights:
Fixed a fee schedule upload failure by tracing a SQL aggregation bug, reproducing the file workflow locally, adding regression coverage, and auditing related implementations.
Created Flyway migrations and runbook updates for a claims-data purge procedure, then validated behavior with SQL smoke tests in shared environments.
Improved Jenkins security scanning by moving OWASP dependency-check into a fail-fast pipeline stage and adding scheduled scan jobs across shared components and API repositories.
Remediated high and critical dependency findings in shared Java components by updating managed dependency versions, removing temporary suppressions, and publishing a fixed release.
Designed production-like API load tests using Datadog traffic patterns and database-derived test inputs.
Used CloudWatch production metrics to validate container resource needs and support an architecture decision around CPU, memory, and peak-traffic headroom.
Core tools: Java, Spring Boot, PostgreSQL, SQL, Maven, Flyway, Jenkins, Docker, AWS, CloudWatch, Datadog, JMeter, OWASP Dependency-Check.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · PostgreSQL · Spring Boot · SQL · Jenkins · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) · Maven · Flyway · Docker · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Amazon CloudWatch · JMeter · OWASP · Automated Software Testing · REST APIs · Debugging

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Built healthcare data integration systems using HL7v2/FHIR, enabling secure exchange of clinical messages across hospitals and labs.

- Developed and tested REST APIs (Java Spring, Groovy/Spock) to modernize Medicare claims adjudication.

- Delivered large-scale APIs in Go on Azure for CDC lab result processing and secure hospital delivery.

- Designed microservices to digitize testing workflows, reducing manual data entry between hospitals and labs.

- Designed and maintained CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure-as-code in Azure and AWS for scalable deployments.

- Strengthened code quality by reducing technical debt, improving automated tests, and refining test naming conventions.

- Built applications using both the MVC architecture and MERN stack, ensuring clean design patterns and full-stack delivery.

- Enhanced architectural documentation with impact-focused context, improving onboarding and knowledge transfer.

- Promoted asynchronous collaboration across time zones through clear task handoffs and shared ownership.

- Championed mob programming adoption, co-leading training and practice to boost collaboration, knowledge sharing, and code quality.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Web Applications · JavaScript · Software Infrastructure · Software Design · Software Industry · Engineering · Web Engineering · Team Building · DevOps · React.js · Node.js · Back-End Web Development · Microservices · PostgreSQL

positions.title: Program Coordinator
positions.description:
- Served as acting program coordinator for CIBER under the direct supervision of the director, managing activities under tight deadlines.

- Streamlined and organized departmental processes, improving efficiency and coordination across programs.

- Assisted with planning and coordination of university-wide events, including the STEM Expo, Kent County Science Fair, and Fall Ag Recruitment.

- Coordinated and promoted Estab­lished Program to Stim­u­late Com­pet­i­tive Research (EPSCoR) student events in collaboration with the University of Delaware, Wesley College, Delaware Technical Community College, and other partner institutions.

- Supported K–12 teacher workshops statewide while also assisting graduate and undergraduate student programming.

- Engaged with faculty, staff, and external collaborators to strengthen partnerships and outreach.

- Maintained and managed multiple university websites, including CIBER’s official site (ciber.desu.edu), the DSU i-Tree webpage, and The Ethics Resource Site.

- Ensured websites were responsive, accurate, and updated to meet program and institutional needs.

- Consistently delivered high-quality work with strong attention to detail and accountability.

positions.title: Outreach and Website Coordinator
positions.description:
- Worked as part-time Communications Coordinator at Delaware State University’s CIBER, supporting planning and coordination of Center activities.

- Gained experience working under tight deadlines and high-pressure environments while ensuring smooth program execution.

- Helped streamline and organize departmental processes, improving efficiency across daily operations.

- Collaborated with external partners, including the University of Delaware, Wesley College, Delaware Technical Community College, and other institutions, to coordinate joint programs and events.

- Assisted graduate and undergraduate students and helped coordinate K–12 teacher workshops across the state.

- Maintained and managed multiple university websites, including CIBER’s official site (ciber.desu.edu), the DSU i-Tree website, and The Ethics Resource Site.

- Demonstrated commitment to the Center’s success through strong attention to detail, effective communication, and a collaborative approach.

positions.title: Urban Forestry Researcher
positions.description: As an urban forestry researcher for Delaware State University, I have been in charge of the current urban forestry projects for the University. I completed a website detailing the the ecological processes of all the tress on campus .

positions.title: Java Developer
positions.description:
- Completed a comprehensive apprenticeship in Full-Stack Java Development at The Software Guild.

- Learned and applied software design fundamentals including wireframing, CRUD interface design, and Agile development practices.

- Built a Java console-based MVC CRUD application (DVD Library) using NetBeans to strengthen Java programming fundamentals.

- Developed an OpenWeather REST Client with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and JSON to integrate live API data.

- Designed and implemented relational databases using SQL Server, with hands-on experience in query writing, data modeling, and schema design.

- Built a Superhero Sightings Spring MVC web application with HTML/CSS/JS/Bootstrap (frontend) and Java + MySQL (backend), including full database persistence and JUnit DAO testing.

- Utilized GitHub for version control and code review, practicing professional collaboration workflows.

- Continued learning by tutoring beginner Python students and expanding into .NET/C# and Python.

Key Skills Gained:
Java · HTML5 · CSS3 · JavaScript · OOP · Data/Class Modeling · jQuery · Bootstrap · GitHub · Debugging · Spring JDBC · REST APIs · Software Architecture · TDD · Agile
positions.insights: Skills: Website Development · Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) · Microservices · Java · JavaScript · Software Infrastructure · Web Engineering

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description: During my time as a graduate research assistant, I help gather social and scientific evidence to build reports and make competent and informed recommendations to local legislators.

positions.title: Urban Forestry Researcher
positions.description: Pioneering the use of i-Tree software for the purpose of creating a sample inventory of city trees.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description: Assisted current Center for Energy and Environmental Policy staff and faculty in research on energy policy with an emphasis in sustainable energy utilities.

positions.title: Research Intern
positions.description: During my internship with the State of Delaware, I was allowed hands-on working experience with a researcher at the St. Jones Estuarine Reserve. I worked a lot with marsh-drainage/soil erosion projects such as those involving watershed drainage monitoring in the Kitts Hummock area of Dover, Delaware, and tide observations at the Bombay Hook Wildlife Reserve. I was also involved in, and helped maintain, ongoing water quality monitoring along the St. Jones River.
